goal: 在学术会议上顺利完成演讲,并得体地回应听众提问、与听众有效互动

n1.speaker: 主持人 Dr. Harris (会议主席)
n1.line: Ladies and gentlemen, I am delighted to introduce our next speaker, who will present her findings on the impact of artificial intelligence on higher education.
n1.lineCn: 女士们先生们,我很高兴向大家介绍下一位演讲者,她将报告关于人工智能对高等教育影响的研究发现。

grammar.name: It is widely acknowledged that...
grammar.note: 学术演讲开场的经典句式:被动化的认知动词引出公认观点,既客观又正式,如 It is widely acknowledged that AI is reshaping education.

options.text: Good morning, everyone. It is widely acknowledged that artificial intelligence is reshaping education, yet the empirical evidence remains surprisingly limited.
options.textCn: 大家早上好。人们普遍认为人工智能正在重塑教育,然而实证证据却出人意料地有限。
options.feedback: 出色的开场:先承认公认观点,再用 yet 转折亮出研究缺口,既正式又抓人。

options.text: Hi guys, so I guess I will talk about AI and schools and stuff, I hope you like it.
options.textCn: 嗨,各位,我猜我要讲讲人工智能和学校那些事儿,希望你们喜欢。
options.feedback: guys、stuff 等口语词在学术演讲中不合时宜,内容也空洞,主席不得不提醒你重新开始。

options.text: I am sorry, I have not prepared any slides, so I will just say a few words.
options.textCn: 抱歉,我没准备任何幻灯片,所以我就随便说几句。
options.feedback: 开场先为准备不足道歉,严重损害可信度,需要重新组织开场。

n2.speaker: 听众 A (提问者)
n2.line: Thank you for that opening. Could you clarify how you operationalised the term "learning outcomes" in your study?
n2.lineCn: 感谢你的开场。你能说明一下研究中是如何把“学习成果”这个术语操作化定义的吗?

grammar.name: Could you clarify how...
grammar.note: 学术讨论中礼貌提问的句式:could + 询问动词 + how 引导的宾语从句,比 can 更委婉正式。

options.text: Certainly. I operationalised it as measurable improvements in students' performance on standardised assessments over one academic semester.
options.textCn: 当然。我将其操作化为:学生在一整个学期内,标准化测评成绩的可测量提升。
options.feedback: 定义严谨、用词正式 (operationalise, standardised assessments),完美回应了提问。

options.text: Learning outcomes are basically how well students do in their exams, I suppose.
options.textCn: 学习成果基本上就是学生在考试中考得怎么样,我猜是这样。
options.feedback: basically、I suppose 等模糊口语削弱了定义的精确性,听众要求你重新表述。

options.text: I do not think I need to explain that; everyone in this room knows what it means.
options.textCn: 我觉得这不用解释,在座各位都知道它是什么意思。
options.feedback: 回避定义问题显得傲慢,违背学术交流的基本礼节。

n3.speaker: 主持人 Dr. Harris (会议主席)
n3.line: Perhaps you might begin again, framing your topic in a more formal register so that the audience can follow your argument.
n3.lineCn: 也许你可以重新开始,用更正式的语体来组织话题,以便听众跟上你的论证。

grammar.name: Perhaps you might...
grammar.note: 委婉建议句式:perhaps + might 弱化命令感,是学术场合提醒他人的得体说法。

options.text: Thank you for the guidance. To begin with, I intend to examine the extent to which AI tools enhance autonomous learning among undergraduates.
options.textCn: 感谢指点。首先,我打算考察人工智能工具在多大程度上促进了本科生的自主学习。
options.feedback: 用 To begin with 和 the extent to which 重建正式开场,成功挽回局面。

options.text: Fine. So, um, AI is a big thing now and lots of universities use it, right?
options.textCn: 好吧。那,嗯,人工智能现在可火了,好多大学都在用,对吧?
options.feedback: 仍是口语填充语 (um, a big thing, right?),未按要求提升语体,演讲难以为继。

options.text: Sorry, I am rather nervous. Could I perhaps begin from the middle instead?
options.textCn: 抱歉,我有点紧张。我可以从中间开始讲吗?
options.feedback: 怯场且避开开场结构,听众难以跟上,演讲只能草草收场。

n4.speaker: 听众 B (质疑样本量)
n4.line: Your data are impressive, but I wonder whether the sample of eighty students is sufficient to support such a bold conclusion.
n4.lineCn: 你的数据令人印象深刻,但我怀疑八十名学生的样本是否足以支撑如此大胆的结论。

grammar.name: I wonder whether...
grammar.note: 委婉质疑的句式:直接否定显得粗鲁,而 I wonder whether 把质疑包装成疑问,是学术圈通用做法。

options.text: That is a fair point. To a certain extent, I concede the sample is modest; however, the effect remains statistically significant at the 0.01 level.
options.textCn: 你说得有道理。在某种程度上,我承认样本偏小;然而,该效应在 0.01 水平上仍具有统计显著性。
options.feedback: 先承认、再限定、最后用证据反击,典型的学术回应,既谦逊又有力。

options.text: I disagree entirely. My sample is perfectly adequate, and I fail to see any problem with it.
options.textCn: 我完全不同意。我的样本非常充足,我看不出有任何问题。
options.feedback: 全盘否定、毫不让步,防御性过强,讨论气氛迅速恶化。

options.text: A fair concern. I shall address the sampling limitations shortly, as they are acknowledged in the discussion section.
options.textCn: 合理的关切。我稍后会谈到样本局限,讨论部分对此也有所交代。
options.feedback: 承认关切并预告处理方式,态度得体,讨论得以继续。

n5.speaker: 听众 A (要求重新表述)
n5.line: I am not sure I follow. In essence, could you restate that definition in plainer terms?
n5.lineCn: 我不太确定自己理解了。从本质上说,你能用更平实的语言重述一下那个定义吗?

grammar.name: In essence
grammar.note: 学术口语中表示“本质上”的过渡短语,用于概括核心含义,常与 restate 搭配使用。

options.text: Certainly. In essence, the term refers to the extent to which students' test scores improve over the course of a single semester.
options.textCn: 当然。本质上,这个术语指的是学生的考试成绩在一个学期内的提升幅度。
options.feedback: 用 In essence 清晰重述,解释到位,提问者满意,回到主线。

options.text: It is obvious, is it not? I assumed everyone in this room would understand.
options.textCn: 这很明显,不是吗?我以为在座各位都该懂。
options.feedback: 反问加居高临下的语气,让听众感到被冒犯,交流彻底中断。

options.text: What I mean is that I measured whether students got better at exams after using the software.
options.textCn: 我的意思是我衡量了学生用了这个软件之后考试是不是变好了。
options.feedback: 意思大致准确,但表述仍偏口语,算勉强通过的回答。

n6.speaker: 听众 C (混淆因素挑战)
n6.line: You attribute the improvement to AI, but is it not equally plausible that highly motivated students simply happen to use these tools more?
n6.lineCn: 你把进步归因于人工智能,但同样可能的是:高动机的学生恰好更多地使用这些工具,难道不是吗?

grammar.name: Is it not equally plausible that...?
grammar.note: 学术反驳的经典句式:用反诘句提出替代解释 (rival explanation),既尖锐又礼貌。

options.text: Although it is true that motivation may confound the results, we controlled for prior attainment and study time in the regression analysis.
options.textCn: 诚然,动机可能混淆结果,但我们在回归分析中控制了先前成绩和学习时间。
options.feedback: although 让步加控制变量的证据反击,句式与内容俱佳,完美化解质疑。

options.text: No, that is not true at all. You are completely wrong about my study.
options.textCn: 不,完全不对。你对我的研究完全理解错了。
options.feedback: 直接否定对方且毫无依据,激化了对抗,会场气氛难以为继。

options.text: I appreciate the point. In fact, we compared two matched cohorts precisely to rule out that possibility.
options.textCn: 我理解这一点。事实上,我们正是通过比较两个匹配队列来排除这种可能性的。
options.feedback: 肯定对方观点并给出具体应对,交流顺畅,质疑也得到解答。

n7.speaker: 听众 B (伦理问题)
n7.line: Before we move on, did you obtain ethical clearance for the data collected from underage participants?
n7.lineCn: 在我们继续之前,请问你获得收集未成年参与者数据的伦理审批了吗?

grammar.name: Before we move on
grammar.note: 会议讨论中转移话题前的过渡语,表示“在我们继续之前”,让提问衔接自然得体。

options.text: Yes, indeed. Ethical clearance was granted by the university committee, and all participants provided informed consent.
options.textCn: 是的。伦理审批已获大学委员会批准,所有参与者均签署了知情同意书。
options.feedback: 直接、完整地给出审批与知情同意信息,展示研究规范性。

options.text: Ethics? I did not think it was necessary for such a small project.
options.textCn: 伦理?我认为这么小的项目没有必要吧。
options.feedback: 轻视伦理审批是学术大忌,听众对你的专业性产生严重质疑。

options.text: All procedures were approved in advance; I can share the reference number with you after the session.
options.textCn: 所有程序均事先获批,会后我可以把审批编号提供给你。
options.feedback: 给出关键信息并主动提供凭证,回应完整得体。

n8.speaker: 主持人 Dr. Harris (会议主席)
n8.line: We are running short of time. In conclusion, could you distil your principal takeaway into one or two sentences?
n8.lineCn: 我们时间不多了。最后,你能用一两句话提炼出你最主要的结论吗?

grammar.name: In conclusion
grammar.note: 总结环节的标准提示语,听众据此预期你收束全文,而非引入新观点。

options.text: In conclusion, AI tools, when carefully integrated, yield a modest yet consistent improvement in learning outcomes, particularly for weaker students.
options.textCn: 总而言之,人工智能工具在精心整合的情况下,能带来温和而稳定的学习成果提升,对较弱学生尤其明显。
options.feedback: 一句话总结核心发现并点明适用对象,干净利落,主席满意收场。

options.text: To wrap up, I guess AI is pretty good for education, and I hope you all enjoyed my talk. Thanks!
options.textCn: 总之,我猜人工智能对教育挺好的,希望你们喜欢我的演讲。谢谢!
options.feedback: 总结空洞、语体随意 (guess, pretty good),与正式的开场腔调脱节,留有遗憾。

options.text: To conclude, the evidence suggests that well-designed AI tutoring benefits lower-achieving students the most, which carries clear policy implications.
options.textCn: 总而言之,证据表明设计良好的 AI 辅导对低成就学生帮助最大,这具有明确的政策含义。
options.feedback: 结论既有发现又有延伸意义,收尾完整专业。

success.speaker: 主持人 Dr. Harris (会议主席)
success.line: A rigorous presentation and a series of insightful answers. Thank you, and please join me in thanking our speaker.
success.lineCn: 一场严谨的报告和一系列富有洞见的回答。谢谢你,请大家一起感谢我们的演讲者。

grammar.name: A rigorous presentation
grammar.note: rigorous (严谨的) 是学术评价高频词,常形容研究方法或报告本身,而非 speaker。

fail1.speaker: 主持人 Dr. Harris (会议主席)
fail1.line: I am afraid our session must move on. We thank you for sharing your initial ideas today.
fail1.lineCn: 恐怕我们的环节必须继续了。我们感谢你今天分享的初步想法。

grammar.name: I am afraid...
grammar.note: 正式场合礼貌打断或婉拒的软语标记,后面常接 must,弱化直接冲突。

fail2.speaker: 听众 B (质疑者)
fail2.line: Thank you for your time. Given the concerns raised, I trust the written paper will address these issues in greater depth.
fail2.lineCn: 感谢你的时间。鉴于提出的这些疑虑,我相信书面论文会更深入地处理这些问题。

grammar.name: Given the concerns raised
grammar.note: given + 名词短语表示“鉴于……”,是学术口头与书面中交代背景条件的正式结构。
